title: Random Hootenannies
description: This project adds a few things that I have made. It's more just a collection of small additions than a large content mod.
body:
This mod contains random things that I have made.

Version 1;

**Lacewood**- A new wood type found within the savanah.

**Rhodium**- A new metal that has a chance of replacing gold ore when generating, it is used to plate golden tools and armour. Currently there is no smithing template, use the rhodium nugget instead.

**Botanist**- A new villager profession that buys and sells plants. It uses the decorated pot as a word station.

Version 1.0.1;

**Nice and Shiny**- A new acheivement for obtaining a full set of Rhodium Armor
